QUOTE: `not_indexed` (extensions the index never read, such as `.rs`, `.toml`, `.sql`, `.csv`, extensionless files, and `.lock`)
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The item requires naming the file types that were in scope and produced no rows. The answer names only extensions the index never read (`not_indexed`), which is the opposite category, and it never says the reply lists in-scope file types that returned nothing.
